source: Synthetic: an MG R20 K=18 per-second record built to the corpus-pinned offsets (docs/protocol/whoop.md, fourth/fifth source, ~2M records): HR 64 at body[11], skin temp 33.20 C as i16 LE 3320 at body[62:64], sleep state SLEEP (2) in bits 5-4 of body[70]. Residual and refuted bytes carry non-zero noise so the decoder provably ignores them; the tri-mode SpO2 byte holds diagnostic code 0x08 that must never surface as a percentage. Regenerate from a real capture in the hardware epoch.
